build_fpn_backbone: build a Feature Pyramid Network backbone with ResNet bottom-up and configurable output channels
build_retinanet_fpn_backbone: build a RetinaNet-compatible FPN backbone with P6 and P7 extra downsampled feature levels
create_fpn_pyramid_features: create multi-scale pyramid features from ResNet backbone feature maps using top-down fusion
create_lastlevel_max_pool: create a LastLevelMaxPool module that generates a downsampled P6 feature from P5 via max pooling
create_lastlevel_p6p7: create a LastLevelP6P7 module that generates P6 and P7 convolutional layers from C5 feature maps
